description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonProjects class, a custom widget for rendering a remove button in subpanels for the Projects module within the SuiteCRM system. It handles rendering the delete link with proper permissions and confirmation prompts.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonProjects
classes.description: A widget class extending SugarWidgetField to display remove buttons in project subpanels.
